```lean4
import Mathlib

theorem rmo_2000_2
  (x y : ℕ)
  (hx : 0 < x)
  (hy : 0 < y)
  (h : y ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8) :
  x = 9 ∧ y = 11 := by
  have h₁ : x ≤ 9 := by
    by_contra hx'
    have hx'' : x ≥ 10 := by omega
    have h₂ : (x + 2) ^ 3 < y ^ 3 := by
      calc
        (x + 2) ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 6 * x ^ 2 + 12 * x + 8 := by ring
        _ < x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by
          have : 0 < 2 * x ^ 2 - 18 * x := by
            nlinarith
          omega
        _ = y ^ 3 := by rw [h]
    have h₃ : x + 2 < y := by
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) (Nat.le_of_not_ge (fun h => by
        have : y ≤ x + 2 := by omega
        have : y ^ 3 ≤ (x + 2) ^ 3 := by
          exact Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_left this 3
        omega))
    have h₄ : y ≥ x + 3 := by omega
    have h₅ : y ^ 3 ≥ (x + 3) ^ 3 := by
      exact Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_left h₄ 3
    have h₆ : (x + 3) ^ 3 > x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by
      calc
        (x + 3) ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 9 * x ^ 2 + 27 * x + 27 := by ring
        _ > x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by
          have : 0 < x ^ 2 + 33 * x + 19 := by nlinarith
          omega
    omega
  
  interval_cases x <;> norm_num at h ⊢ <;>
    (try omega) <;>
    (try {
      have : y ≤ 20 := by
        nlinarith [pow_two y, pow_two (y - 1)]
      interval_cases y <;> norm_num at h ⊢ <;> omega
    })
```
